name: atqaa-team04-medusa-automation
description: ATQAA Team04 - Medusa.js staging test automation (Postman/Newman, Playwright, k6)

scripts.test:api: newman run postman/collections/Team04_Medusa_API_Collection.postman_collection.json -e postman/environments/Medusa_Staging_Env.postman_environment.json -r cli,htmlextra --reporter-htmlextra-export reports/Team04_API_Automation_Report.html --reporter-htmlextra-title "Team04 Medusa API Automation Report"
scripts.test:api:ddt: newman run postman/collections/Team04_Medusa_API_Collection.postman_collection.json -e postman/environments/Medusa_Staging_Env.postman_environment.json -d postman/data/test_data_checkout.csv -r cli,htmlextra --reporter-htmlextra-export reports/Team04_API_Automation_Report.html --reporter-htmlextra-title "Team04 Medusa API Automation Report (DDT)"
scripts.test:api:ci: npm run warmup && npm run test:api:ddt
